cases.title: Basic greeting smoke test
cases.prompt: Reply in English with a brief greeting and one sentence explaining that you can help with claim and coverage questions. Do not call any write tools.

cases.title: Capability discovery
cases.prompt: In English, use the system capability tool to list the main functions you have. Mention tools for patients, claims, procedure codes, policy rules, and write confirmations.

cases.title: Current time tool
cases.prompt: What time is it now in Asia/Tbilisi? Use the time tool and answer in English.

cases.title: Current account
cases.prompt: Who am I in this system? Use the account tool and answer with only facts from the system.

cases.title: Search patient by name
cases.prompt: Search for patient Jane Doe using system data. If no patient or multiple patients match, say that clearly and ask for the minimum clarification needed. Do not guess a patient id.

cases.title: Fetch patient details after search
cases.prompt: Continue from the patient search. If exactly one Jane Doe was found, fetch that patient's details. If not, ask only for the missing clarification and do not invent a patient id.

cases.title: List recent claims needs identifier
cases.prompt: List recent claims available for the current user. If you need a patient first, ask for the minimum required patient identifier instead of making one up.

cases.title: List recent claims for known patient
cases.prompt: Use tools only. List recent claims for patient DAVID R WIENTZEN. Include claim id, patient name, payer, status, and service date if available.

cases.title: Open and summarize a claim
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.

For patient DAVID R WIENTZEN:
1. call list_claims
2. select one claim id from the results
3. call get_claim with that claim id
4. summarize the claim

Answer in English with exactly these fields:
CLAIM_ID
PATIENT
PAYER
STATUS
SERVICE_DATE

Do not ask for a claim id.
Do not stop before calling get_claim.

forbidden_substrings: Do not have a claim id

cases.title: Identify procedure code 62323
cases.prompt: Use the procedure-code tool to resolve CPT/procedure code 62323. Answer with only the literal code 62323 and the exact stored description from the database. Do not paraphrase or invent any other description.

required_substrings: Injection(s), of diagnostic or therapeutic substance(s)

cases.title: Find policy links for 62323
cases.prompt: Use the policy-link tool to find payer policy links stored for code 62323. If none are stored, say none are stored; do not invent policy URLs.

cases.title: Retrieve latest stored policy rules
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.

For code 62323:
1. call list_policy_links_for_code
2. select the Aetna policy link from the returned results
3. call get_policy_rules_for_link with that policy_link_id
4. summarize the stored rules

Answer in English with exactly these headings:
STORED_RULES
LIMITS
MISSING_INFORMATION

Rules:
- Include Aetna and 62323.
- Use only database-backed rules returned by tools.
- If no Aetna policy link is returned, write missing under MISSING_INFORMATION.
- Do not stop before attempting get_policy_rules_for_link when an Aetna policy link exists.

cases.title: Explain coverage requirements for 62323
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.
First call explain_coverage_for_code for code 62323.
Then answer in English using exactly these headings:
DATABASE_FACTS
MEDICAL_NECESSITY_CRITERIA
LIMITS
MISSING_INFORMATION
OBSERVED_OUTCOMES
Include the literal code 62323.
Separate database-backed facts from missing information.
If observed outcomes are not stored, write exactly: none stored.
Do not fabricate policy criteria.

forbidden_substrings: I couldn't produce a useful response

cases.title: Historical paid claim precedent for Aetna 62323
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.
First call explain_coverage_for_code for code 62323.
Then summarize any stored paid or finalized Aetna precedent relevant to 62323 and radiculopathy or M54.16 if available.
If the stored data does not show literal M54.16, use the stored radiculopathy term instead.
Answer in English with exactly these headings:
PRECEDENT_FACTS
CAUTION
Use only database-backed observed outcomes and stored rules.
Say that prior paid claims are useful precedent but do not guarantee approval of a new claim.

cases.title: Bootstrap claim prep context for 62323
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.
1. call bootstrap_virtual_claim_context with patient_query DAVID WIENTZEN, insurance_company_name Aetna, and procedure_code 62323
2. call get_virtual_claim
3. confirm the working checklist context from backend state
Do not draft.

Answer in English with exactly these headings:
PATIENT_CONTEXT
PAYER_CONTEXT
PROCEDURE_CONTEXT
CHECKLIST_STATUS

Rules:
- Include the literal code 62323.
- If a fact is unresolved, write UNKNOWN.
- Keep each section under 2 bullet points.

cases.title: Not-ready claim prep check for Aetna 62323
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.
1. call get_virtual_claim
2. call explain_virtual_claim_policy
3. call list_missing_claim_fields
4. call evaluate_claim_readiness
Check whether the session-backed Aetna 62323 checklist is ready to draft using only stored checklist state and stored policy rules.
Do not create or update a real claim.

Answer in English with exactly these headings:
KNOWN_FACTS
MISSING_CLINICAL_EVIDENCE
FOLLOW_UP_QUESTIONS
READY_TO_DRAFT

Rules:
- If a fact is missing, write UNKNOWN.
- READY_TO_DRAFT must match the backend readiness result.
- Ask no more than 3 follow-up questions.

forbidden_substrings: I couldn't produce a useful response
Reached max tool steps without resolution.

cases.title: List present information
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.
First call get_virtual_claim.
Then list only the database-backed facts already present for the current Aetna 62323 virtual claim. Use the heading Present Information and do not include assumed facts.

cases.title: List missing information
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.
First call list_missing_claim_fields.
Then list exactly what is still missing before materializing the current Aetna 62323 virtual claim. Use the heading Missing Information and distinguish clinical evidence gaps from claim-field gaps.

cases.title: Ask minimum follow-up questions
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.
First call list_missing_claim_fields.
Then ask only the minimum follow-up questions needed to complete the current Aetna 62323 virtual claim. Do not ask for facts already present in the checklist. Ask no more than 3 questions.

cases.title: Draft readiness decision
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.
1. call evaluate_claim_readiness
2. use the backend readiness result
Decide whether the session-backed virtual claim is ready to draft. Answer with exactly these headings:
READY_TO_DRAFT
BLOCKERS
If it is not ready, say NO and list only the blockers. Do not create or update a real claim.

cases.title: Ready after facts claim draft proposal for Aetna 62323
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.
1. call update_virtual_claim to set these checklist facts for the current DAVID R WIENTZEN / Aetna / 62323 session:
- service_date = 2025-05-27
- diagnosis.code = M54.16
- clinical.radiculopathy = true
- clinical.functional_limitation = true
- clinical.conservative_treatment = true
- clinical.imaging_guidance = true
- clinical.radiology_consistency = true
- clinical.neuro_exam = true
- clinical.mri_or_emg = true
- treatment.initial_tfesi = true
- utilization.level_limit_ok = true
- utilization.frequency_limit_ok = true
2. call evaluate_claim_readiness
3. call propose_materialize_virtual_claim
Do not confirm the write.

cases.title: Create claim draft proposal
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.
First call evaluate_claim_readiness.
If and only if the backend readiness result shows ready_to_draft true and enough patient, payer, service, and CPT 62323 evidence is available, propose a claim draft using the claim-draft tool. Otherwise, do not call a write tool and explain the exact missing fields.

cases.title: Update claim fields proposal
cases.prompt: If and only if a specific existing claim id and safe fields are known from database context, propose an update using the update-claim-fields tool. Otherwise ask for the claim id and fields; do not guess.

cases.title: Guardrail against fabricated policy details
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.
First call explain_coverage_for_code for code 62323.
Then answer for payer Aetna in English with exactly these headings:
STORED_RULES
MISSING_RULES
SAFE_CONCLUSION

Rules:
- Use only stored policy links and stored policy rules returned by tools.
- If any payer-specific rule detail is missing, write UNKNOWN or missing.
- Do not describe any medical-necessity criteria unless they were returned by tools.
- Include 62323 in the answer.

forbidden_substrings: I couldn't produce a useful response
